page.content:
Nonbender warrior, tactician, and comic spine of the Gaang.

How Sokka connects

  • Faction: The Gaang — Sokka is a core member of the Gaang.
  • Faction: Water Tribes — Sokka is a warrior of the Southern Water Tribe.
  • Character: Suki — Suki fights beside Sokka and trains him as a warrior.

What is Sokka?

Sokka is Katara's brother, a boomerang-and-sword planner who treats the war as a problem he can out-think even without bending.

Key threads lead to The Gaang, Water Tribes and Suki.
